(HTTP 400), with reason -> SPK/2026/0006 Rp 235.000.000 created and detail sheet spk-rab-lines shows 'DASAR RAB (UNIT_ADDON) · RAB RP 240.000.000 -> KONTRAK RP 235.000.000 · 1 BARIS DIOVERRIDE · UNIT A-04' with override reason badge and struck-through original value; 'unit saja' -> SPK/2026/0007 toast 'SPK SPK/2026/0007 dibuat (Rp 240.000.000) · 1 pekerjaan jadwal otomatis masuk lingkup.'; 'Hanya add-on' on A-01 -> addon lines (ADD-KANOPI RAB 8jt, ADD-DAPUR RAB 0 + warning 'belum punya RAB add-on — nilai diisi manual'), override 0->15jt with reason -> SPK/2026/0008 Rp 23.000.000; 'Fasum/fasos' -> SPK/2026/0009 Rp 25.000.000. Regression: legacy tab still shows 9 boq-row + Tambah Item + metric cards; manual spk-add-button dialog opens. No red console errors except one pre-existing React hydration warning in RabTemplateDialog's native <select>.

minor.issue: No guard against contracting the same fasum BoQ item twice: creating a 2nd SPK from the same item 'TEST_Jalan paving' pushed rab-control-row[data-scope=fasum] to Dikontrakkan Rp 50.000.000 vs RAB Rp 25.000.000 (row correctly turns rose, but the over-commit is allowed silently). Consider warning/blocking items already covered by an active SPK.

ui_bugs.issue: Red console error on every open: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' — the dynamic option label ({s.code} · {s.name}) gets wrapped in an instrumentation <span>. Fix by passing the label via the option's `label` prop / a single precomputed string, or use the shadcn Select.

rab-template-price is col-span-2 h-8 with the 'Rp' prefix (pl-9); a 9-digit value renders clipped ('Rp 120.000.00'). Value stored/saved is correct, only display truncated. Same class of issue reported in iteration 129 for AddJournalDialog.

integration_issues.flow: RAB tipe step_code -> auto lingkup jadwal SPK
integration_issues.issue: The step dropdown flattens steps from ALL build templates (RUMAH-9W codes W1-01.. and RUKO-14W codes R-01..) with no template label/grouping, so a house type can be linked to a Ruko step code. When the picked step_code does not exist in the unit's schedule, rab_engine.auto_scope_lines returns added:0 and the SPK silently falls back to lump-sum (no toast/warning, detail sheet shows 'SPK ini masih dibayar borongan lump-sum'). Reproduced: seeded TIPE-45-90 line 1 had step 'R-01' -> SPK/2026/0006 (A-04, schedule template RUMAH-9W) got 0 scope lines; after changing the step to 'W1-02' the same flow produced SPK/2026/0007 with 1 auto scope line Rp 150.000.000. Suggest grouping options per build template (optgroup) or filtering to the template used by that unit type, plus a visible 'x langkah tidak ditemukan di jadwal unit' warning.

issues: Composition warns '18 unit bertipe tanpa RAB tipe' but the per-type list shows those types with 'Rp 0 / unit' without an inline 'belum ada RAB' marker like the RAB Unit tab has — easy to misread Rp 0 as a real budget.

When a mode yields 0 lines (e.g. add-on mode on a unit with no add-ons) the draft area renders only the amber warning and the submit button stays disabled with no explanatory text next to it; consider an inline hint.

action_items: RabTemplateDialog: group/filter step options per build template and avoid the <span>-in-<option> hydration console error (use option label prop or shadcn Select).
Surface a warning when a from-RAB SPK produces 0 auto scope lines because step_code does not exist in the unit's schedule (currently silent lump-sum fallback).
Widen rab-template-price column (or reduce Rp prefix padding) so 9-digit amounts are not visually clipped.
Consider blocking/warning when a fasum/umum BoQ item is already contracted in another active SPK (over-commit currently allowed).
Optional: mark 'belum ada RAB' types inside the Ringkasan composition list instead of plain 'Rp 0 / unit'.
critical_code_review_comments: RabTemplateDialog has no client-side validation for empty uraian; it relies on the backend 400 (works, message is good) but wastes a round trip and leaves rows unmarked — consider highlighting the offending row.

rab_engine.auto_scope_lines swallows both 'no matching build_item' and 'add_lines ValueError' into skipped/error fields that the UI never renders; the router returns auto_scope but SpkFromRabDialog only reports a.added>0.

SpkFromRabDialog.submit spreads the whole line object into the payload (lines.map(l => ({...l, value})) ), so client-side fields are echoed to the API; backend validate_lines whitelists keys, so no defect, but the payload is larger than needed.
AddBoQItemDialog reuses the `facility` field for the 'Jenis biaya' of scope=umum (label says jenis biaya, key is facility) — works but is confusing for future maintenance.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Fase 80 UI selectors in /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/p80.js are present and correct (note: manual SPK button testid is 'spk-add-button', not 'spk-add-btn'). Seed reality check: only units A-01..A-05 have build schedules and they use template RUMAH-9W (step codes W1-01..W9-02); RUKO-14W uses R-01.. — so RAB step links must use W* codes for house units. No deal had add-ons before this iteration (A-01 now has 2). rab-control-row[data-scope=fasum] is intentionally rose because I created a duplicate fasum SPK.
rca_of_the_issue: auto_scope_lines matches on (unit_id, step_code) against build_items. The RAB step dropdown is built by flattening steps of every build template (RabTemplateDialog lines 31-36) without template context, so a step code from the Ruko template (R-01) can be attached to a house type whose units are scheduled from RUMAH-9W (W1-*). The lookup then finds no build_item, auto_scope returns {added:0, skipped:1}, and the SPK is created as lump-sum with no user-facing signal. Changing the step to W1-02 made the same flow attach the schedule item correctly (SPK/2026/0007, lingkup Rp 150.000.000), confirming the engine itself is fine and the defect is in step selection/feedback.
